frames.title: Lesson 80 · be inclined to do — use

body: **Foco:** be inclined to do — uso.
**Pronúncia:** Organização da informação pela entonação.
**22 palavras novas** (comunicação intercultural).
**Texto do dia:** editorial / opinião.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar be inclined to do para expressar uma tendência ou opinião com cautela, em um editorial.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Editorial: Listening Before Leading
paras: Managers who work abroad are often **inclined to assume** that their own style is the norm. Colleagues from high-context cultures, however, are **inclined to read** silence as respect, not as agreement. We are **inclined to think** that most conflicts begin with small misreadings.
That is why we are **inclined to support** the city’s new training plan. Staff who are **inclined to learn** from others will adapt faster; those **disinclined to listen** will not.
We are not **inclined to believe** that cultural awareness comes by itself. It must be taught, practised and rewarded.

items.q: The editors think cultural awareness comes by itself.
Some colleagues read silence as respect.
The training plan costs a lot of money.

blocks.body: **be inclined to** suaviza uma opinião ou descreve um hábito: é mais **cauteloso** que *I think* ou *I will*.
Depois de **inclined to** vem o **infinitivo**: ✗ *inclined to thinking*.

items.s: We are ___ to think that conflicts start small. (inclined)
Staff who are inclined to ___ will adapt. (learn)
He is ___ to listen to advice. (disinclined)
I am inclined to ___ with the editors. (agree)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Are we inclined to support the plan
items.pt: Estamos inclinados a apoiar o plano?

items.ans: It must include practice not only lectures
items.pt: Deve incluir prática, não apenas palestras.

items.expt: It is only a tentative claim.
The editors gave a measured response.
My personal leaning is to wait.
Silence is not a default assumption.

body: **I am inclined to agree.** — Tendo a concordar.
**Lean towards a view.** — Pender para uma visão.
**For the most part,…** — Em sua maior parte,…
**Take it with a pinch of salt.** — Receber com desconfiança.
**Sit on the fence.** — Ficar em cima do muro.
**Play devil’s advocate.** — Fazer o advogado do diabo.
**A matter of degree.** — Uma questão de grau.
**Be of two minds.** — Estar dividido.
**Are we inclined to support the plan?** — Estamos inclinados a apoiar o plano?
**What condition?** — Qual condição?
**It must include practice, not only lectures.** — Deve incluir prática, não apenas palestras.

forms: He assumes the rules are the same.

blocks.title: Newsroom
lines: Are we inclined to support the plan?
Estamos inclinados a apoiar o plano?
I am inclined to say yes, with one condition.
Estou inclinado a dizer sim, com uma condição.
It must include practice, not only lectures.
Deve incluir prática, não apenas palestras.

blocks.title: Pronúncia: Organização da informação pela entonação

items.label: Organização da informação pela entonação
items.note: Organização da informação pela entonação: a informação nova ou final recebe a nota que cai; listas e ideias incompletas sobem.
words: We need time ↗, money ↗, and trust ↘.
If it fails ↗, we try again ↘.
Having left early ↗, she missed it ↘.

prompts.q: Give a cautious opinion about remote work.
prompts.model: I am inclined to think it suits some jobs better than others.

prompts.q: Say what you tend to do when you disagree.
prompts.model: I am inclined to listen first.
I am disinclined to decide without data.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence editorial paragraph with be inclined to.
blocks.model: We are inclined to welcome the new language policy. Managers who are inclined to listen will learn more than those who are inclined to lecture. We are not inclined to believe that one training day is enough. Still, it is a first step. Staff should feel inclined to share their experience. That is how culture changes.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
